_comment: Claim 15 at the paper's full scale (Fig. 5; App. E.4 table): parametric softmax with 2,560,000 trained keys of width 3,072 and 10-dim values, all 50,000 CIFAR-10 training images with augmentation, batch 64, Adam 3e-3 (lowest rate of the paper's grid), T = 1, plain softmax (fixed equal weights). bf16 parameters and Adam moments (about 63 GB; fp32 would need about 126 GB). The paper trains 2,000 epochs (about 40 GPU-hours here); this run is stopped when its time budget is used, and the logged evaluations (every 5 epochs, 2,000 test and 2,000 non-augmented training images) cover the start of training, where the paper's test accuracy peaks (~3-5% of training) and starts to fall.
